evidence: Dicobaltoctacarbonyl [Co2(CO)8] with 1%–5% hexane (Alfa Aesar, USA) was used as a cobalt source while ozone (O3) was used as the second precursor. O3 (99%) was generated by an ozone generator that was fed 95% pure O2 from air using an oxygen concentrator. Throughout all ALD reactions, ca. 200 sccm N2 (99.999%) flow was maintained by a mass flow controller, which increased the base pressure of the reactor by 1 Torr.
